author: SaifJawasreh
quote: It's Game of the Year, whether Nintendo kids like it or not. Rockstar spent all these years producing the best Grand Theft Auto installment, and then some Nintendo kid comes along and drops the "Best Game of the Year" rating. Keep crying, Nintendo kids!

author: SaifJawasreh
quote: A game as bad as its audience, who have the brains of children. If you don't like GTA 6, don't cry like a baby over its 99 rating. Cry all you want, Nintendo kids.
